issues: Extraneous leftover page markers included as standalone lines: "2 –", "3 -", and "4 –" (not part of legal text; disrupt structure).
Broken numbering/list structure in Article 1: item 5 in the original is merged with item 6 on the same line; translation separates them, so list-item boundaries do not match the source.
Meaning drift in Article 1(4): Indonesian 'harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan' is rendered as 'human dignity and dignity' (duplicative/incorrect).
Scrambled/incorrect list structure in Article 6: item (3) is rendered as "5 - (3)" instead of "3." and is not aligned with the numbering format of (1) and (2).
Scrambled/incorrect list structure in Article 12: item (3) is merged into item 2 instead of appearing as a separate numbered item "3.".

Minor meaning drift/awkwardness in Article 4: "baik dari individu, kelompok atau lembaga" means protection/handling provided by individuals/groups/institutions; translation reads as if confidentiality is "from" them. Recast to preserve meaning without adding content.
Scrambled numbering in Article 6: original shows a stray page marker "5 - (3)"; translation normalizes it to "3." which changes the list-marker structure used for downstream splitting.

Leftover non-legal/page-break artifacts retained: "6 -" appears in translation (also present in original) and should be kept only if it is part of the source; however the mismatch in Article 6 marker indicates the artifact was not preserved consistently.

Scrambled/flattened list structure in Article 12: Paragraph (1) and Paragraph (2) are run together on one line; sub-items a. and b. are not clearly separated; the dash list under b. is in-line instead of as distinct list items, risking boundary-based parsing errors.
Minor meaning/term drift: 'mediocolegal' should be 'medico-legal' to match the original term usage/standard rendering.
